units.rawText: Looks like it's time to recount the past... I found myself in Cyclopes when I woke up from the Neural Cocoon.

units.rawText: I thought I could seek shelter there as a Doll of Svarog Heavy Industries, but I saw the Sanctifier named Raven heading to Cyclopes when I was on my way.
units.displayText: I thought I could seek shelter there as a Doll of Svarog Heavy Industries, but I saw the Sanctifier named Raven heading to Cyclopes when I was on my way.

spans.text: I thought I could seek shelter there as a Doll of Svarog Heavy Industries, but I saw the Sanctifier named Raven heading to Cyclopes when I was on my way.

units.rawText: That Sanctifier had an uncanny aura; I dared not approach... So I had to change my route, whereupon I met you and Simo.

units.rawText: I see... So our encounter was more or less a stroke of luck.

spans.text: I see... So our encounter was more or less a stroke of luck.

units.rawText: Ahaha. I've always had good luck. Though I wandered for a long time, I met no danger.

spans.text: Ahaha. I've always had good luck. Though I wandered for a long time, I met no danger.

units.rawText: ...Honestly, I wasn't going to stay at the Oasis, because I've got my own missions to complete despite being trapped in the Cloud. I held some hesitation, thoroughly intending to visit Helios first.

units.rawText: But you helped me with my situation, Professor. Not only did you arrange a testing field for me, but you also granted me the necessary privileges to continue my research. I'm truly grateful for your assistance.

units.rawText: Your research is more than personal—it's a beacon of hope for humanity. It carries the promise that, perhaps one day, humanity will return to the skies.

units.rawText: Yeah, you're right... Since you're here, Professor, why don't we take to the sky and relax for a bit? Don't worry, I'll be flying more gently this time.
